   311	void beginHaloCopies(double* field,
   312	                     const std::size_t localNz,
   313	                     const std::size_t plane,
   314	                     const int previous,
   315	                     const int next,
   316	                     HaloBuffers& buffers,
   317	                     const bool cudaAwareMpi,
   318	                     const cudaStream_t stream,
   319	                     const int rank) {
   320	    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
   321	    if (previous == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   322	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream), rank);
   323	    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
   324	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendLower, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream), rank);
   325	    }
   326	    if (next == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   327	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
   328	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream),
   329	                   rank);
   330	    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
   331	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendUpper, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
   332	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
   333	                   rank);
   334	    }
   335	}

   337	void finishHaloExchange(double* field,
   338	                        const std::size_t localNz,
   339	                        const std::size_t plane,
   340	                        const int previous,
   341	                        const int next,
   342	                        const int lowerTag,
   343	                        const int upperTag,
   344	                        HaloBuffers& buffers,
   345	                        const bool cudaAwareMpi,
   346	                        const cudaStream_t stream,
   347	                        const int rank) {
   348	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
   349	
   350	    MPI_Request requests[4];
   351	    int requestCount = 0;
   352	    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
   353	    if (previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   354	        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field : buffers.recvLower;
   355	        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + plane : buffers.sendLower;
   356	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, upperTag,
   357	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
   358	                  rank);
   359	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, lowerTag,
   360	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
   361	                  rank);
   362	    }
   363	    if (next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   364	        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field + (localNz + 1) * plane : buffers.recvUpper;
   365	        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + localNz * plane : buffers.sendUpper;
   366	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, lowerTag,
   367	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
   368	                  rank);
   369	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, upperTag,
   370	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
   371	                  rank);
   372	    }
   373	    if (requestCount != 0) {
   374	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(requestCount, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE), rank);
   375	    }
   376	
   377	    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
   378	    if (!cudaAwareMpi && previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   379	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, buffers.recvLower, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream), rank);
   380	    }
   381	    if (!cudaAwareMpi && next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   382	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, buffers.recvUpper, bytes,
   383	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
   384	                   rank);
   385	    }
   386	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
   387	}

   511	bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& local, const int rank) {
   512	    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
   513	    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
   514	    int localInvalid = 0;
   515	
   516	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
   517	    for (std::int64_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::int64_t>(local.size()); ++index) {
   518	        const double value = local[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
   519	        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
   520	            localInvalid = 1;
   521	        } else {
   522	            localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
   523	            localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
   524	        }
   525	    }
   526	
   527	    double globalMin = 0.0;
   528	    double globalMax = 0.0;
   529	    int globalInvalid = 0;
   530	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
   531	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
   532	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
   533	
   534	    int valid = 1;
   535	    if (rank == 0) {
   536	        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
   537	            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   538	            valid = 0;
   539	        }
   540	        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
   541	        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
   542	            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   543	            valid = 0;
   544	        }
   545	    }
   546	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
   547	    return valid != 0;
   548	}

   550	int runBenchmark(const Configuration& config,
   551	                 const int rank,
   552	                 const int size,
   553	                 const int localRank,
   554	                 const int localSize,
   555	                 const int device,
   556	                 const bool cudaAwareMpi) {
   557	    const std::size_t nx = static_cast<std::size_t>(config.nx);
   558	    const std::size_t ny = static_cast<std::size_t>(config.ny);
   559	    const std::size_t nz = static_cast<std::size_t>(config.nz);
   560	    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
   561	    const std::size_t globalCells = plane * nz;
   562	    const Decomposition domain = decompose(nz, size, rank);
   563	    const std::size_t localCells = domain.localNz * plane;
   564	    const std::size_t allocatedCells = (domain.localNz + 2) * plane;
   565	
   566	    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
   567	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device), rank);
   568	    if (rank == 0) {
   569	        std::printf("Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\n");
   570	        std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
   571	        std::printf("Time steps: %d\n", config.iterations);
   572	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", config.validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   573	        std::printf("Parallel configuration: %d MPI rank(s), up to %d OpenMP thread(s)/rank, "
   574	                    "%d rank(s) on rank 0's node\n",
   575	                    size, omp_get_max_threads(), localSize);
   576	        std::printf("Rank 0 GPU: %s (device %d, local rank %d)\n", properties.name, device, localRank);
   577	        std::printf("MPI GPU transport: %s\n", cudaAwareMpi ? "direct device buffers" : "pinned host staging");
   578	        std::printf("Initializing concentration field...\n");
   579	    }
   580	
   581	    DeviceFields fields(allocatedCells, rank);
   582	    HaloBuffers halo(plane, rank);
   583	    cudaStream_t computeStream = nullptr;
   584	    cudaStream_t communicationStream = nullptr;
   585	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&computeStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking), rank);
   586	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communicationStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking), rank);
   587	    cudaEvent_t potentialReady = nullptr;
   588	    cudaEvent_t concentrationReady = nullptr;
   589	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&potentialReady, cudaEventDisableTiming), rank);
   590	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&concentrationReady, cudaEventDisableTiming), rank);
   591	
   592	    std::vector<double> initial(localCells);
   593	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   594	    for (std::int64_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::int64_t>(localCells); ++index) {
   595	        const std::size_t globalIndex = domain.zOffset * plane + static_cast<std::size_t>(index);
   596	        const double pseudo = static_cast<double>(((globalIndex + 1) * std::size_t{1299709}) % globalCells) /
   597	                              static_cast<double>(globalCells);
   598	        initial[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
   599	    }
   600	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(fields.cold + plane, initial.data(), localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), rank);
   601	    initial.clear();
   602	    initial.shrink_to_fit();
   603	
   604	    const int previous = rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1;
   605	    const int next = rank + 1 == size ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1;
   606	
   607	    if (rank == 0) std::printf("Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\n");
   608	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize(), rank);
   609	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
   610	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   611	
   612	    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < config.iterations; ++iteration) {
   613	        if (iteration != 0) {
   614	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communicationStream, concentrationReady, 0), rank);
   615	        }
   616	        beginHaloCopies(fields.cold, domain.localNz, plane, previous, next, halo, cudaAwareMpi,
   617	                        communicationStream, rank);
   618	        launchChemicalInterior(fields.cold, fields.mu, nx, ny, plane, domain.localNz, computeStream, rank);
   619	        finishHaloExchange(fields.cold, domain.localNz, plane, previous, next,
   620	                           kConcentrationTagLower, kConcentrationTagUpper, halo, cudaAwareMpi,
   621	                           communicationStream, rank);
   622	        launchChemicalBoundary(fields.cold, fields.mu, nx, ny, plane, domain.localNz, computeStream, rank);
   623	
   624	        // Boundary potential values depend on the concentration halo. Recording this event lets
   625	        // the transfer stream wait without serializing unrelated host work or the whole device.
   626	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(potentialReady, computeStream), rank);
   627	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communicationStream, potentialReady, 0), rank);
   628	        beginHaloCopies(fields.mu, domain.localNz, plane, previous, next, halo, cudaAwareMpi,
   629	                        communicationStream, rank);
   630	        launchUpdateInterior(fields.cold, fields.mu, fields.cnew, nx, ny, plane, domain.localNz,
   631	                             computeStream, rank);
   632	        finishHaloExchange(fields.mu, domain.localNz, plane, previous, next,
   633	                           kPotentialTagLower, kPotentialTagUpper, halo, cudaAwareMpi,
   634	                           communicationStream, rank);
   635	        launchUpdateBoundary(fields.cold, fields.mu, fields.cnew, nx, ny, plane, domain.localNz,
   636	                             computeStream, rank);
   637	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(concentrationReady, computeStream), rank);
   638	        std::swap(fields.cold, fields.cnew);
   639	    }
   640	
   641	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(computeStream), rank);
   642	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
   643	    const double localSeconds = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   644	    double seconds = 0.0;
   645	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localSeconds, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
   646	
   647	    if (rank == 0) {
   648	        const double milliseconds = seconds * 1000.0;
   649	        const double updates = static_cast<double>(globalCells) * static_cast<double>(config.iterations);
   650	        const double mcups = seconds > 0.0 ? updates / seconds / 1.0e6 : 0.0;
   651	        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", milliseconds);
   652	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   653	    }
   654	
   655	    std::vector<double> localResult;
   656	    if (config.printResults || config.validate) {
   657	        localResult = copyOwnedResult(fields.cold, localCells, plane, rank);
   658	    }
   659	    if (config.printResults) {
   660	        std::vector<double> globalResult = gatherResult(localResult, nx, ny, nz, rank, size);
   661	        if (rank == 0) print_results(globalResult, "Concentration");
   662	    }
   663	
   664	    bool valid = true;
   665	    if (config.validate) {
   666	        if (rank == 0) std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   667	        valid = validateDistributed(localResult, rank);
   668	        if (rank == 0) std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   669	    }
   670	
   671	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(potentialReady), rank);
   672	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(concentrationReady), rank);
   673	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(computeStream), rank);
   674	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communicationStream), rank);
   675	    return valid ? 0 : 1;
   676	}

   722	        const std::size_t nz = static_cast<std::size_t>(config.nz);

   734	                const std::size_t globalCells = plane * nz;

   740	                    inputValid = 0;

   766	    int anyGpuFailure = 0;

   770	        MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator);

   773	    }
   774	
   775	    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;
   776	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device), rank);

   785	
   786	    const int result = runBenchmark(config, rank, size, localRank, localSize, device, cudaAwareMpi != 0);
   787	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localCommunicator), rank);
   788	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize(), rank);
   789	    return result;

+Decomposition decompose(const std::size_t nz, const int size, const int rank) {
+    const std::size_t base = nz / static_cast<std::size_t>(size);
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % static_cast<std::size_t>(size);
+    const std::size_t rankValue = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    return {base + (rankValue < remainder ? 1U : 0U),
+            rankValue * base + std::min(rankValue, remainder)};
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ values,
+                                             const std::size_t nx,
+                                             const std::size_t ny,
+                                             const std::size_t plane,
+                                             const std::size_t x,
+                                             const std::size_t y,
+                                             const std::size_t z,
+                                             const double inverseDx2,
+                                             const double inverseDy2,
+                                             const double inverseDz2) {
+    const std::size_t centerIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double center = values[centerIndex];
+    const double left = values[x == 0 ? centerIndex : centerIndex - 1];
+    const double right = values[x + 1 == nx ? centerIndex : centerIndex + 1];
+    const double down = values[y == 0 ? centerIndex : centerIndex - nx];
+    const double up = values[y + 1 == ny ? centerIndex : centerIndex + nx];
+    return (left + right - 2.0 * center) * inverseDx2 +
+           (down + up - 2.0 * center) * inverseDy2 +
+           (values[centerIndex - plane] + values[centerIndex + plane] - 2.0 * center) * inverseDz2;
+}

+                                        const std::size_t firstZ,
+                                        const std::size_t zCount,
+                                        const double inverseDx2,
+                                        const double inverseDy2,
+                                        const double inverseDz2,
+                                        const double gamma) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t z = firstZ + blockIdx.z * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= firstZ + zCount) return;
+
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double value = concentration[index];
+    constexpr double eAA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eBB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eAB = 2.0 / 9.0;
+    potential[index] = 4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * eAA + (value - 1.0) * eBB - 2.0 * value * eAB) +
+                       3.0 * value + value * value * value -
+                       gamma * laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialBoundaryKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                                double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                                const std::size_t nx,
+                                                const std::size_t ny,
+                                                const std::size_t plane,
+                                                const std::size_t localNz,
+                                                const double inverseDx2,
+                                                const double inverseDy2,
+                                                const double inverseDz2,
+                                                const double gamma) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;
+    const std::size_t z = blockIdx.z == 0 ? 1 : localNz;
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double value = concentration[index];
+    constexpr double eAA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eBB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eAB = 2.0 / 9.0;
+    potential[index] = 4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * eAA + (value - 1.0) * eBB - 2.0 * value * eAB) +
+                       3.0 * value + value * value * value -
+                       gamma * laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ potential,
+                             double* __restrict__ result,
+                             const std::size_t nx,
+                             const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t plane,
+                             const std::size_t firstZ,
+                             const std::size_t zCount,
+                             const double inverseDx2,
+                             const double inverseDy2,
+                             const double inverseDz2,
+                             const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t z = firstZ + blockIdx.z * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= firstZ + zCount) return;
+
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    result[index] = concentration[index] +
+                    dtTimesD * laplacian(potential, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaryKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                     double* __restrict__ result,
+                                     const std::size_t nx,
+                                     const std::size_t ny,
+                                     const std::size_t plane,
+                                     const std::size_t localNz,
+                                     const double inverseDx2,
+                                     const double inverseDy2,
+                                     const double inverseDz2,
+                                     const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;
+    const std::size_t z = blockIdx.z == 0 ? 1 : localNz;
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    result[index] = concentration[index] +
+                    dtTimesD * laplacian(potential, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+void beginHaloCopies(double* field,
+                     const std::size_t localNz,
+                     const std::size_t plane,
+                     const int previous,
+                     const int next,
+                     HaloBuffers& buffers,
+                     const bool cudaAwareMpi,
+                     const cudaStream_t stream,
+                     const int rank) {
+    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
+    if (previous == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream), rank);
+    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendLower, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream), rank);
+    }
+    if (next == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream),
+                   rank);
+    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendUpper, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
+                   rank);
+    }
+}
+
+void finishHaloExchange(double* field,
+                        const std::size_t localNz,
+                        const std::size_t plane,
+                        const int previous,
+                        const int next,
+                        const int lowerTag,
+                        const int upperTag,
+                        HaloBuffers& buffers,
+                        const bool cudaAwareMpi,
+                        const cudaStream_t stream,
+                        const int rank) {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
+
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+    int requestCount = 0;
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    if (previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field : buffers.recvLower;
+        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + plane : buffers.sendLower;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, upperTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, lowerTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+    }
+    if (next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field + (localNz + 1) * plane : buffers.recvUpper;
+        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + localNz * plane : buffers.sendUpper;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, lowerTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, upperTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+    }
+    if (requestCount != 0) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(requestCount, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE), rank);
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
+    if (!cudaAwareMpi && previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, buffers.recvLower, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream), rank);
+    }
+    if (!cudaAwareMpi && next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, buffers.recvUpper, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
+                   rank);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
+}
+
+void launchChemicalInterior(const double* concentration,
+                            double* potential,
+                            const std::size_t nx,
+                            const std::size_t ny,
+                            const std::size_t plane,
+                            const std::size_t localNz,
+                            const cudaStream_t stream,
+                            const int rank) {
+    if (localNz <= 2) return;
+    constexpr dim3 block(32, 4, 2);
+    const std::size_t zCount = localNz - 2;
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((zCount + block.z - 1) / block.z));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, nx, ny, plane, 2, zCount,
+                                                         1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}
+
+void launchChemicalBoundary(const double* concentration,
+                            double* potential,
+                            const std::size_t nx,
+                            const std::size_t ny,
+                            const std::size_t plane,
+                            const std::size_t localNz,
+                            const cudaStream_t stream,
+                            const int rank) {
+    constexpr dim3 block(32, 8, 1);
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    localNz == 1 ? 1U : 2U);
+    chemicalPotentialBoundaryKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, nx, ny, plane,
+                                                                 localNz, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}
+
+void launchUpdateInterior(const double* concentration,
+                          const double* potential,
+                          double* result,
+                          const std::size_t nx,
+                          const std::size_t ny,
+                          const std::size_t plane,
+                          const std::size_t localNz,
+                          const cudaStream_t stream,
+                          const int rank) {
+    if (localNz <= 2) return;

+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((zCount + block.z - 1) / block.z));

+void launchUpdateBoundary(const double* concentration,

+std::vector<double> copyOwnedResult(const double* device,
+                                    const std::size_t localCells,
+                                    const std::size_t plane,
+                                    const int rank) {
+    std::vector<double> result(localCells);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(result.data(), device + plane, localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), rank);
+    return result;
+}
+
+std::vector<double> gatherResult(const std::vector<double>& local,
+                                 const std::size_t nx,
+                                 const std::size_t ny,
+                                 const std::size_t nz,
+                                 const int rank,
+                                 const int size) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    std::vector<double> global;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        global.resize(plane * nz);
+        std::copy(local.begin(), local.end(), global.begin());
+        for (int source = 1; source < size; ++source) {
+            const Decomposition sourceDomain = decompose(nz, size, source);
+            std::size_t remaining = sourceDomain.localNz * plane;
+            std::size_t offset = sourceDomain.zOffset * plane;
+            while (remaining != 0) {
+                const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                    remaining, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())));
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Recv(global.data() + offset, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, source, kGatherTag,
+                                   MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE),
+                          rank);
+                offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+                remaining -= static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
             }
         }
+    } else {
+        std::size_t remaining = local.size();
+        std::size_t offset = 0;
+        while (remaining != 0) {
+            const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                remaining, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())));
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Send(local.data() + offset, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, kGatherTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+            offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+            remaining -= static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+        }
     }
+    return global;
 }

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& local, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (std::int64_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::int64_t>(local.size()); ++index) {
+        const double value = local[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
+        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
+            localInvalid = 1;
+        } else {
+            localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+            localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
         }
     }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    return valid != 0;
 }

+void mpiCheck(const int result, const char* operation, const int rank) {
+    if (result == MPI_SUCCESS) return;

+    int length = 0;

+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, result);
+    std::abort();

+Decomposition decompose(const std::size_t nz, const int size, const int rank) {
+    const std::size_t base = nz / static_cast<std::size_t>(size);
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % static_cast<std::size_t>(size);
+    const std::size_t rankValue = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    return {base + (rankValue < remainder ? 1U : 0U),
+            rankValue * base + std::min(rankValue, remainder)};
+}
+
+class DeviceFields {
+  public:

+        const std::size_t bytes = elements * sizeof(double);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&cold), bytes), rank_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&cnew), bytes), rank_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&mu), bytes), rank_);
+    }
+
+    DeviceFields(const DeviceFields&) = delete;
+    DeviceFields& operator=(const DeviceFields&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceFields() {
+        if (cold != nullptr) cudaFree(cold);
+        if (cnew != nullptr) cudaFree(cnew);
+        if (mu != nullptr) cudaFree(mu);
+    }
+
+    double* cold = nullptr;
+    double* cnew = nullptr;
+    double* mu = nullptr;
+
+  private:
+    int rank_;
+};
+
+class HaloBuffers {
+  public:
+    HaloBuffers(const std::size_t planeElements, const int rank) : rank_(rank) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_), 4 * planeElements * sizeof(double),
+                                 cudaHostAllocDefault),
+                   rank_);
+        sendLower = storage_;
+        sendUpper = sendLower + planeElements;
+        recvLower = sendUpper + planeElements;
+        recvUpper = recvLower + planeElements;
+    }
+
+    HaloBuffers(const HaloBuffers&) = delete;
+    HaloBuffers& operator=(const HaloBuffers&) = delete;
+
+    ~HaloBuffers() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(storage_);
+    }
+
+    double* sendLower = nullptr;
+    double* sendUpper = nullptr;
+    double* recvLower = nullptr;
+    double* recvUpper = nullptr;
+
+  private:
+    int rank_;
+    double* storage_ = nullptr;
+};

+__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ values,
+                                             const std::size_t nx,
+                                             const std::size_t ny,
+                                             const std::size_t plane,
+                                             const std::size_t x,
+                                             const std::size_t y,
+                                             const std::size_t z,
+                                             const double inverseDx2,
+                                             const double inverseDy2,
+                                             const double inverseDz2) {
+    const std::size_t centerIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double center = values[centerIndex];
+    const double left = values[x == 0 ? centerIndex : centerIndex - 1];
+    const double right = values[x + 1 == nx ? centerIndex : centerIndex + 1];
+    const double down = values[y == 0 ? centerIndex : centerIndex - nx];
+    const double up = values[y + 1 == ny ? centerIndex : centerIndex + nx];
+    return (left + right - 2.0 * center) * inverseDx2 +
+           (down + up - 2.0 * center) * inverseDy2 +
+           (values[centerIndex - plane] + values[centerIndex + plane] - 2.0 * center) * inverseDz2;
+}
+
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx,
+                                        const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t plane,
+                                        const std::size_t firstZ,
+                                        const std::size_t zCount,
+                                        const double inverseDx2,
+                                        const double inverseDy2,
+                                        const double inverseDz2,
+                                        const double gamma) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t z = firstZ + blockIdx.z * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= firstZ + zCount) return;
+
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double value = concentration[index];
+    constexpr double eAA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eBB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eAB = 2.0 / 9.0;
+    potential[index] = 4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * eAA + (value - 1.0) * eBB - 2.0 * value * eAB) +
+                       3.0 * value + value * value * value -
+                       gamma * laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialBoundaryKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                                double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                                const std::size_t nx,
+                                                const std::size_t ny,
+                                                const std::size_t plane,
+                                                const std::size_t localNz,
+                                                const double inverseDx2,
+                                                const double inverseDy2,
+                                                const double inverseDz2,
+                                                const double gamma) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;
+    const std::size_t z = blockIdx.z == 0 ? 1 : localNz;
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double value = concentration[index];
+    constexpr double eAA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eBB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eAB = 2.0 / 9.0;
+    potential[index] = 4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * eAA + (value - 1.0) * eBB - 2.0 * value * eAB) +
+                       3.0 * value + value * value * value -
+                       gamma * laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ potential,
+                             double* __restrict__ result,
+                             const std::size_t nx,
+                             const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t plane,
+                             const std::size_t firstZ,
+                             const std::size_t zCount,
+                             const double inverseDx2,
+                             const double inverseDy2,
+                             const double inverseDz2,
+                             const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t z = firstZ + blockIdx.z * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= firstZ + zCount) return;
+
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    result[index] = concentration[index] +
+                    dtTimesD * laplacian(potential, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaryKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                     double* __restrict__ result,
+                                     const std::size_t nx,
+                                     const std::size_t ny,
+                                     const std::size_t plane,
+                                     const std::size_t localNz,
+                                     const double inverseDx2,
+                                     const double inverseDy2,
+                                     const double inverseDz2,
+                                     const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;
+    const std::size_t z = blockIdx.z == 0 ? 1 : localNz;
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    result[index] = concentration[index] +
+                    dtTimesD * laplacian(potential, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+void beginHaloCopies(double* field,
+                     const std::size_t localNz,
+                     const std::size_t plane,
+                     const int previous,
+                     const int next,
+                     HaloBuffers& buffers,
+                     const bool cudaAwareMpi,
+                     const cudaStream_t stream,
+                     const int rank) {
+    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
+    if (previous == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream), rank);
+    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendLower, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream), rank);
+    }
+    if (next == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream),
+                   rank);
+    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendUpper, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
+                   rank);
+    }
+}
+
+void finishHaloExchange(double* field,
+                        const std::size_t localNz,
+                        const std::size_t plane,
+                        const int previous,
+                        const int next,
+                        const int lowerTag,
+                        const int upperTag,
+                        HaloBuffers& buffers,
+                        const bool cudaAwareMpi,
+                        const cudaStream_t stream,
+                        const int rank) {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
+
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+    int requestCount = 0;
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    if (previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field : buffers.recvLower;
+        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + plane : buffers.sendLower;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, upperTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, lowerTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+    }
+    if (next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field + (localNz + 1) * plane : buffers.recvUpper;
+        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + localNz * plane : buffers.sendUpper;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, lowerTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, upperTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+    }
+    if (requestCount != 0) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(requestCount, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE), rank);
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
+    if (!cudaAwareMpi && previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, buffers.recvLower, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream), rank);
+    }
+    if (!cudaAwareMpi && next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, buffers.recvUpper, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
+                   rank);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
+}
+
+void launchChemicalInterior(const double* concentration,
+                            double* potential,
+                            const std::size_t nx,
+                            const std::size_t ny,
+                            const std::size_t plane,
+                            const std::size_t localNz,
+                            const cudaStream_t stream,
+                            const int rank) {
+    if (localNz <= 2) return;
+    constexpr dim3 block(32, 4, 2);
+    const std::size_t zCount = localNz - 2;
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((zCount + block.z - 1) / block.z));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, nx, ny, plane, 2, zCount,
+                                                         1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}
+
+void launchChemicalBoundary(const double* concentration,
+                            double* potential,
+                            const std::size_t nx,
+                            const std::size_t ny,
+                            const std::size_t plane,
+                            const std::size_t localNz,
+                            const cudaStream_t stream,
+                            const int rank) {
+    constexpr dim3 block(32, 8, 1);
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    localNz == 1 ? 1U : 2U);
+    chemicalPotentialBoundaryKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, nx, ny, plane,
+                                                                 localNz, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}
+
+void launchUpdateInterior(const double* concentration,
+                          const double* potential,
+                          double* result,
+                          const std::size_t nx,
+                          const std::size_t ny,
+                          const std::size_t plane,
+                          const std::size_t localNz,
+                          const cudaStream_t stream,
+                          const int rank) {
+    if (localNz <= 2) return;

+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((zCount + block.z - 1) / block.z));

+                                             1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.01);

+void launchUpdateBoundary(const double* concentration,

+std::vector<double> copyOwnedResult(const double* device,
+                                    const std::size_t localCells,
+                                    const std::size_t plane,
+                                    const int rank) {
+    std::vector<double> result(localCells);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(result.data(), device + plane, localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), rank);
+    return result;
+}
+
+std::vector<double> gatherResult(const std::vector<double>& local,
+                                 const std::size_t nx,
+                                 const std::size_t ny,
+                                 const std::size_t nz,
+                                 const int rank,
+                                 const int size) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    std::vector<double> global;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        global.resize(plane * nz);
+        std::copy(local.begin(), local.end(), global.begin());
+        for (int source = 1; source < size; ++source) {
+            const Decomposition sourceDomain = decompose(nz, size, source);
+            std::size_t remaining = sourceDomain.localNz * plane;
+            std::size_t offset = sourceDomain.zOffset * plane;
+            while (remaining != 0) {
+                const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                    remaining, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())));
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Recv(global.data() + offset, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, source, kGatherTag,
+                                   MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE),
+                          rank);
+                offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+                remaining -= static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
             }
         }
+    } else {
+        std::size_t remaining = local.size();
+        std::size_t offset = 0;
+        while (remaining != 0) {
+            const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                remaining, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())));
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Send(local.data() + offset, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, kGatherTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+            offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+            remaining -= static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+        }
     }
+    return global;
 }

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& local, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (std::int64_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::int64_t>(local.size()); ++index) {
+        const double value = local[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
+        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
+            localInvalid = 1;
+        } else {
+            localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+            localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
         }
     }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    return valid != 0;
 }

codex
Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA solver.

Key changes:

- MPI Z-slab domain decomposition with ghost layers.
- CUDA stencil kernels with overlapped interior computation and halo communication.
- Automatic CUDA-aware MPI; pinned-host staging fallback.
- OpenMP-parallel initialization and validation reductions.
- Per-node GPU assignment and distributed result gathering.
- Optimized native CUDA architecture and `-O3` build configuration.
- Executable remains `cahn_hilliard`; only existing files changed.

+Decomposition decompose(const std::size_t nz, const int size, const int rank) {
+    const std::size_t base = nz / static_cast<std::size_t>(size);
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % static_cast<std::size_t>(size);
+    const std::size_t rankValue = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    return {base + (rankValue < remainder ? 1U : 0U),
+            rankValue * base + std::min(rankValue, remainder)};
+}

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&cnew), bytes), rank_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&mu), bytes), rank_);
+    }

+    DeviceFields& operator=(const DeviceFields&) = delete;

+        if (mu != nullptr) cudaFree(mu);

+class HaloBuffers {
+  public:
+    HaloBuffers(const std::size_t planeElements, const int rank) : rank_(rank) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_), 4 * planeElements * sizeof(double),
+                                 cudaHostAllocDefault),
+                   rank_);
+        sendLower = storage_;
+        sendUpper = sendLower + planeElements;
+        recvLower = sendUpper + planeElements;
+        recvUpper = recvLower + planeElements;
+    }
+
+    HaloBuffers(const HaloBuffers&) = delete;
+    HaloBuffers& operator=(const HaloBuffers&) = delete;
+
+    ~HaloBuffers() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(storage_);
+    }
+
+    double* sendLower = nullptr;
+    double* sendUpper = nullptr;
+    double* recvLower = nullptr;
+    double* recvUpper = nullptr;
+
+  private:

+    double* storage_ = nullptr;

+                                             const std::size_t ny,
+                                             const std::size_t plane,
+                                             const std::size_t x,
+                                             const std::size_t y,
+                                             const std::size_t z,
+                                             const double inverseDx2,
+                                             const double inverseDy2,
+                                             const double inverseDz2) {
+    const std::size_t centerIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double center = values[centerIndex];
+    const double left = values[x == 0 ? centerIndex : centerIndex - 1];
+    const double right = values[x + 1 == nx ? centerIndex : centerIndex + 1];
+    const double down = values[y == 0 ? centerIndex : centerIndex - nx];
+    const double up = values[y + 1 == ny ? centerIndex : centerIndex + nx];
+    return (left + right - 2.0 * center) * inverseDx2 +
+           (down + up - 2.0 * center) * inverseDy2 +
+           (values[centerIndex - plane] + values[centerIndex + plane] - 2.0 * center) * inverseDz2;
+}
+
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                        double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                        const std::size_t nx,
+                                        const std::size_t ny,
+                                        const std::size_t plane,
+                                        const std::size_t firstZ,
+                                        const std::size_t zCount,
+                                        const double inverseDx2,
+                                        const double inverseDy2,
+                                        const double inverseDz2,
+                                        const double gamma) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t z = firstZ + blockIdx.z * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= firstZ + zCount) return;
+
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double value = concentration[index];
+    constexpr double eAA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eBB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eAB = 2.0 / 9.0;
+    potential[index] = 4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * eAA + (value - 1.0) * eBB - 2.0 * value * eAB) +
+                       3.0 * value + value * value * value -
+                       gamma * laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void chemicalPotentialBoundaryKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                                double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                                const std::size_t nx,
+                                                const std::size_t ny,
+                                                const std::size_t plane,
+                                                const std::size_t localNz,
+                                                const double inverseDx2,
+                                                const double inverseDy2,
+                                                const double inverseDz2,
+                                                const double gamma) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;
+    const std::size_t z = blockIdx.z == 0 ? 1 : localNz;
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const double value = concentration[index];
+    constexpr double eAA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eBB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
+    constexpr double eAB = 2.0 / 9.0;
+    potential[index] = 4.5 * ((value + 1.0) * eAA + (value - 1.0) * eBB - 2.0 * value * eAB) +
+                       3.0 * value + value * value * value -
+                       gamma * laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                             const double* __restrict__ potential,
+                             double* __restrict__ result,
+                             const std::size_t nx,
+                             const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t plane,
+                             const std::size_t firstZ,
+                             const std::size_t zCount,
+                             const double inverseDx2,
+                             const double inverseDy2,
+                             const double inverseDz2,
+                             const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t z = firstZ + blockIdx.z * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= firstZ + zCount) return;
+
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    result[index] = concentration[index] +
+                    dtTimesD * laplacian(potential, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaryKernel(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ potential,
+                                     double* __restrict__ result,
+                                     const std::size_t nx,
+                                     const std::size_t ny,
+                                     const std::size_t plane,
+                                     const std::size_t localNz,
+                                     const double inverseDx2,
+                                     const double inverseDy2,
+                                     const double inverseDz2,
+                                     const double dtTimesD) {
+    const std::size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;
+    const std::size_t z = blockIdx.z == 0 ? 1 : localNz;
+    const std::size_t index = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    result[index] = concentration[index] +
+                    dtTimesD * laplacian(potential, nx, ny, plane, x, y, z,
+                                         inverseDx2, inverseDy2, inverseDz2);
+}
+
+void beginHaloCopies(double* field,
+                     const std::size_t localNz,
+                     const std::size_t plane,
+                     const int previous,
+                     const int next,
+                     HaloBuffers& buffers,
+                     const bool cudaAwareMpi,
+                     const cudaStream_t stream,
+                     const int rank) {
+    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
+    if (previous == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream), rank);
+    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendLower, field + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream), rank);
+    }
+    if (next == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream),
+                   rank);
+    } else if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(buffers.sendUpper, field + localNz * plane, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
+                   rank);
+    }
+}
+
+void finishHaloExchange(double* field,
+                        const std::size_t localNz,
+                        const std::size_t plane,
+                        const int previous,
+                        const int next,
+                        const int lowerTag,
+                        const int upperTag,
+                        HaloBuffers& buffers,
+                        const bool cudaAwareMpi,
+                        const cudaStream_t stream,
+                        const int rank) {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
+
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+    int requestCount = 0;
+    const int count = static_cast<int>(plane);
+    if (previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field : buffers.recvLower;
+        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + plane : buffers.sendLower;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, upperTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, previous, lowerTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+    }
+    if (next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        double* const receive = cudaAwareMpi ? field + (localNz + 1) * plane : buffers.recvUpper;
+        double* const send = cudaAwareMpi ? field + localNz * plane : buffers.sendUpper;
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(receive, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, lowerTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE, next, upperTag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[requestCount++]),
+                  rank);
+    }
+    if (requestCount != 0) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(requestCount, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE), rank);
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);
+    if (!cudaAwareMpi && previous != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, buffers.recvLower, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream), rank);
+    }
+    if (!cudaAwareMpi && next != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (localNz + 1) * plane, buffers.recvUpper, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
+                   rank);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), rank);
+}
+
+void launchChemicalInterior(const double* concentration,
+                            double* potential,
+                            const std::size_t nx,
+                            const std::size_t ny,
+                            const std::size_t plane,
+                            const std::size_t localNz,
+                            const cudaStream_t stream,
+                            const int rank) {
+    if (localNz <= 2) return;
+    constexpr dim3 block(32, 4, 2);
+    const std::size_t zCount = localNz - 2;
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((zCount + block.z - 1) / block.z));
+    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, nx, ny, plane, 2, zCount,
+                                                         1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}
+
+void launchChemicalBoundary(const double* concentration,
+                            double* potential,
+                            const std::size_t nx,
+                            const std::size_t ny,
+                            const std::size_t plane,
+                            const std::size_t localNz,
+                            const cudaStream_t stream,
+                            const int rank) {
+    constexpr dim3 block(32, 8, 1);
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    localNz == 1 ? 1U : 2U);
+    chemicalPotentialBoundaryKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, nx, ny, plane,
+                                                                 localNz, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}
+
+void launchUpdateInterior(const double* concentration,
+                          const double* potential,
+                          double* result,
+                          const std::size_t nx,
+                          const std::size_t ny,
+                          const std::size_t plane,
+                          const std::size_t localNz,
+                          const cudaStream_t stream,
+                          const int rank) {
+    if (localNz <= 2) return;
+    constexpr dim3 block(32, 4, 2);
+    const std::size_t zCount = localNz - 2;
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((zCount + block.z - 1) / block.z));
+    updateKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, result, nx, ny, plane, 2, zCount,
+                                             1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.01);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}
+
+void launchUpdateBoundary(const double* concentration,
+                          const double* potential,
+                          double* result,
+                          const std::size_t nx,
+                          const std::size_t ny,
+                          const std::size_t plane,
+                          const std::size_t localNz,
+                          const cudaStream_t stream,
+                          const int rank) {

+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
+                    localNz == 1 ? 1U : 2U);
+    updateBoundaryKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(concentration, potential, result, nx, ny, plane,
+                                                     localNz, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.01);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError(), rank);
+}

+std::vector<double> copyOwnedResult(const double* device,
+                                    const std::size_t localCells,
+                                    const std::size_t plane,
+                                    const int rank) {
+    std::vector<double> result(localCells);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(result.data(), device + plane, localCells * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), rank);
+    return result;
+}
+
+std::vector<double> gatherResult(const std::vector<double>& local,
+                                 const std::size_t nx,
+                                 const std::size_t ny,
+                                 const std::size_t nz,
+                                 const int rank,
+                                 const int size) {
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    std::vector<double> global;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        global.resize(plane * nz);
+        std::copy(local.begin(), local.end(), global.begin());
+        for (int source = 1; source < size; ++source) {
+            const Decomposition sourceDomain = decompose(nz, size, source);
+            std::size_t remaining = sourceDomain.localNz * plane;
+            std::size_t offset = sourceDomain.zOffset * plane;
+            while (remaining != 0) {
+                const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                    remaining, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())));
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Recv(global.data() + offset, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, source, kGatherTag,
+                                   MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE),
+                          rank);
+                offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+                remaining -= static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
             }
         }
+    } else {
+        std::size_t remaining = local.size();
+        std::size_t offset = 0;
+        while (remaining != 0) {
+            const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                remaining, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())));
+            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Send(local.data() + offset, chunk, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, kGatherTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+            offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+            remaining -= static_cast<std::size_t>(chunk);
+        }
     }
+    return global;
 }

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<double>& local, const int rank) {
+    double localMin = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    double localMax = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (std::int64_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::int64_t>(local.size()); ++index) {
+        const double value = local[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
+        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
+            localInvalid = 1;
+        } else {
+            localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+            localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
         }
     }
+
+    double globalMin = 0.0;
+    double globalMax = 0.0;
+    int globalInvalid = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
+        if (globalMax > 10.0 || globalMin < -10.0) {
+            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD), rank);
+    return valid != 0;
 }
